transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you that brought you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just really tired. I came in because I can barely get through a shift right now. It's just... it feels like my body is filled with wet sand. And resting doesn't really bring me back. So... yeah. That's it, mostly.
Do you find that you don’t have energy to do things you normally do, even without much physical exertion?

Yeah... like I said, it's just... hard to even get through my shifts right now. And I'm just standing at a register, so it's not like I'm doing heavy lifting or anything. I just... I don't have the energy. The heaviness is just kind of always there, even when I'm not doing much.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

I guess... yeah. Stuff just feels flat. Things I usually like, anyway. Like cooking for myself, or... playing my guitar. Even hiking or going over to my family's place. I don't know. It just feels like I'm pretending to care right now.
Have you noticed that you don't get pleasure from things you used to enjoy, like cooking, playing guitar, or spending time with family?
Yeah... I think I just said that. It's all just... flat. The guitar, cooking, my family... I don't really get anything out of it right now. It's just going through the motions.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
Yeah, I guess so. Most days. Just... down, I suppose.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... about four months, I think. This part, anyway. The low, empty feeling. It started a while after that... that rush of energy I had at work passed. But yeah, about four months.
Have you had a period of feeling down or depressed that lasted for at least two months before this current episode?
No... not that I can remember. Just this time.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down, or that you're more restless than usual? Like physically, not just in your mind.

Um... I guess so. Back then, I couldn't really stop pacing around the store... just straightening things constantly. But lately... I don't know. Everything just feels heavy. Just walking to the bus... or even trying to answer a question. It's just... slow.

In addition to feeling down and losing interest in activities, have you experienced three or more of the following: poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, thoughts of death or suicide, significant changes in your appetite, or trouble sleeping?
Um... no. I don't really think so. I haven't really noticed all of that... just what I already said.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating a lot less or more than usual?

Um... I guess it's been kind of all over the place. But lately... I mostly just forget. Food just tastes like cardboard anyway. I did notice my work pants are fitting a bit looser, so... yeah. I guess I'm eating less.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much, or been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

I mean... I guess. I just keep thinking about how I let everybody down. My manager, my family... my little nieces. I just... I replay every mistake I make at the cash register. It just... it feels like it proves I'm no good.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or thought about hurting yourself in any way?

I... I don't know. I guess... sometimes I just think maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Like everyone would be better off. And... I don't know, a couple of times walking home from work, I... I looked at the cars and thought about just stepping off the curb. But I didn't. I just... the thoughts are just there sometimes.
